name: After § 12
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 12a. Regrets the unprecedented levels of attacks on the United Nations and its paramount role in peacebuilding and conflict resolution, and stresses the need for the EU and its Member States to defend the United Nations and work within the United Nations systems and in a manner consistent with the United Nations Charter to achieve the peaceful resolution of disputes;
